skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Blade-cleaved Tides
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Blade-cleaved Tides. Thorns bares his blade, and Iberia's fleet sets sail after a century of silence. A golden secret has emerged in lawless lands, and seas of sand and salt can no longer conceal its radiance.
skins.usage: One of Thorns's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'Once more has the tide returned to Iberia, and it follows the point of my sword. Do you hear the command of the waves as they crash upon the shore? They call upon Iberia to set sail once more.'

skins.name: Cómodo
skins.content: I.T Brand UNDER GARDEN Collab Outfit/Cómodo. A black and white base, the third color freely selectable. A casual design, a multi-modular composition for balanced action/everyday effect.
skins.quote: Have fun on vacation. Do not disturb at work.
